about.statement: I engineer systems that scale, stream, and think.
about.bio: Software Engineer at EY GDS with 2+ years building production-grade full-stack and cloud-native applications. I specialize in FastAPI microservices, React frontends, Azure infrastructure, and AI-driven automation — writing code that ships, scales, and makes real impact.

bullets: Owned end-to-end full-stack features using FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, and MS SQL Server for enterprise cloud migration initiatives.
Architected RESTful APIs and real-time layers via WebSockets and SSE — delivering live data streaming with sub-second latency.
Spearheaded AI automation with Semantic Kernel and Microsoft Agent Framework, reducing manual cloud analysis effort by ~40%.
Designed API contracts with FastAPI + Pydantic, eliminating integration errors across multiple microservices.
Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps, measurably improving deployment speed.
Led technical code reviews in Agile sprints, maintaining high quality across the team.
Developed core bidding platform using React.js and Django, increasing component reusability by ~40%.
Built and maintained Django REST APIs + React components in Docker, integrated with PostgreSQL.
Managed AWS deployments and database migrations during release cycles, minimizing downtime.
